Excellent VN. Great art and sound track with a colorful and realistic cast set in a richly detailed world.

A really cool visual novel.
It kind of shows you how hard it is to become a professional RTS player.
Or an overall Esports player for that matter.
took me about a hour and a half to complete i feel bad the backers paid for this it seems like half a book
I'm gonna kill myself if a sequel never releases.

Not my usual cup of tea--visual novels, esports--but... I got really in to this and blazed straight through! 

Among other things, the characters are extremely well-developed, differentiated, and I came to feel quite involved/invested in thier various dramas and overall journey.

Really well done; highly recommended!
Franchement très sympa et très divertissant, malgré la durée de vie assez courte on s'attache au personnages facilement !
Great game, even if you don't know SC2.

For a Visual Novel that's free, I expected it to be awful. I'm not gonna lie, I've never played Starcraft, and I only got it to give it a go, but I found it seriously well made, and I got really attatched to the characters. To be honest, I'm thinking of even trying out the prequel and sequal, because I found it so enthralling.

I'd recommend it, but I suggest you already have decent knowledge of Starcraft prior, so you don't have to check the game's glossary (Which is a cool feature to have!) as much as I did.
